items.summary: Rural goods retailer Tractor Supply (NASDAQ:TSCO) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026 as sales rose 2.3% year on year to $4.54 billion. Its GAAP profit of $0.81 per share was 1.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
